_loinc_survey_doc: LOINC-side recall survey (Loinc.csv of the pinned LOINC release): regexes on COMPONENT / PROPERTY / SYSTEM that select the LOINC terms a laboratory physician would count as this analyte (CLASSTYPE 1, not DEPRECATED). The generator reports how many of them the LOINC Ontology pool reaches.

queries.name: Refined Query V2 Quantitative (Measurement Properties)
queries.description: Uses Component = Methemoglobin (with descendants to capture variants like cyanmethemoglobin) AND Property = Measurement property (universal parent) for quantitative measurements. Excludes ratio-based measurements like Methemoglobin/Hemoglobin ratios.

queries.name: Refined Query V2 Ratio (Ratio Properties)
queries.description: Uses Component = Methemoglobin (with descendants) AND Property = Ratio for ratio-based measurements. This captures Methemoglobin/Hemoglobin.total ratios and similar relative measurements.
